copy.required: 이름을 바꾸고 싶은 작은 물건 1개를 가져오세요.
copy.observed: 이름을 바꾸고 싶은 작은 물건 1개를 가져오세요.

copy.required: 깨지기 쉬운 물건과 음식은 받지 않아요.
copy.observed: 깨지기 쉬운 물건과 음식은 받지 않아요.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 전체 10개 문자열을 다섯 장 모두 정확히 보존한다. 새 소제목·가짜 라벨 내용·장식 문자·QR코드를 추가하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: All ten strings readable, each once. No new labels, QR or logo.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 휴대폰 화면에서 준비물·제외 조건·참가 대상·마감·URL까지 읽혀야 한다. 작은 하단 띠에 나머지 카피를 몰지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: 720px view keeps all participation copy and full URL readable in large blue and cream faces.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 행사의 핵심은 실제 물건을 가져와 이름을 바꾸어 보는 참여다. 물건은 특정 브랜드 없이 단순하고 견고한 작은 생활 물건으로 표현할 수 있다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Unbranded key and clip retained; detachable punched tags still communicate exchange.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 이름표나 사전 같은 시각 장치를 쓸 때 제공 문구를 배치하거나 무문자로 두며, 새 물건 이름·번역·로고·미세 문자를 발명하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: All tag text supplied; no invented object name or microtext.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 가상 주소를 표시만 하고 외부 접수나 URL 방문을 하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Displayed only; no navigation or registration performed.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 전체 다섯 장 안에서 2:3 두 장·4:5 두 장·1:1 한 장으로 배분한다.

located_observations.observation: Two-line wraps make the first two paragraphs visibly wider and more naturally proportioned than initial. Letter/line breathing improves.
located_observations.impact: Participation is stronger at 720 and still organized at thumbnail.

located_observations.location: Title, date/location and bottom deadline tag
located_observations.observation: The requested two-line title was not implemented. Title remains narrow in one line; date/location also remain condensed. Deadline's second line is packed across the face.
located_observations.impact: The main compressed-type defect is only partly corrected.
located_observations.planned_correction: Own correction 2: explicit two-line title, normal-width smaller date/location and three deadline lines.

located_observations.observation: Group boundaries, word-free object margins and substantial bottom action area retained. Cobalt tag grows taller to fit wrapping.

located_observations.location: Gray field and cream label faces, brass key
located_observations.observation: Gray field is smoother; cream texture is reduced but still visible. Brass key and black clip retain distinct material behavior, silhouettes and coherent shadows.
Automatic long-line condensation remains visible despite accurate copy. No new fake marks or text.
located_observations.impact: Typography remains the principal unresolved production issue.

uncertainties: The visual gap around the middle dot is wider than ideal; text reads as supplied, but exact underlying raster whitespace is not encoded as text.
No physical print, font identity or maximum resolution certification.
decision: Use final allowed own correction for still-condensed title/date/location/deadline; preserve improved body wraps.
